comment: The estate, as this repository knows it. Every gate resolves a repository
through this file and nowhere else, so 'which repos exist' is one edit in
one place rather than a constant repeated in six scripts.
'github' is the slug --mode clone fetches. null means there is no public
remote, and 'why_no_remote' says why. A check that needs such a repo does
not pass: it reports NOT MEASURED, names the repo, and the run ends
PARTIAL. That is the honest degrade, and it is deliberately visible.
'local' is the directory name beside this one, which is not always the
GitHub name: Engram, Idryx and Qryx are checked out capitalised.
'runs' names the components this repository contributes to a running
stack, in the canonical kind names C5 compares deployments by. An empty
list means the repository runs nothing: a spec, a library, a Terraform
provider, a deployment or the docs. The field is REQUIRED on every entry,
and a repository without one fails C5 rather than being skipped. That is
the whole point of it: before this field existed, C5 compared the three
deployments against a hand-written list of eight service names, so a
component that no deployment installed at all was invisible to the one
gate whose subject is which components come up. vouchryx was added to
this file on 2026-08-26 and installable by nothing, and nothing went red.

agent-passport.role: the spec. Canonical schemas and the SPEC.md 6.2 event-type registry.

agent-stack-go.role: the shared Go module. Wire types, the chain, the pinned cross-language vectors.

tokenfuse.role: the money plane. Owns the Breaker wire strings, the price book and the trace Parquet schema.

verdryx.role: the quality plane. Holds hand-copied mirrors of three tokenfuse constants.

engram.role: the memory plane. Vendors the event schema as a test fixture and pins the chain vectors.

idryx.role: the identity plane. Consumes the envelope; the registry says it emits nothing into it.

qryx.role: the crypto plane. Emits four event types.

wardryx.role: the policy plane. Emits seven event types.

mockryx.role: the simulation plane. Emits three event types.

heraldyx.role: the notifier. Reads the shared log and writes its own dispatch journal in the same envelope.

scopyx.role: the web-egress enforcement point. Decides each destination against the policy plane before a backend fetches it, and writes its own journal in the same envelope.

genaryx.role: the console. Vendors both event schemas and appends console_command lines to the bus.

terraform-provider-taipan.role: the Terraform provider. Consumes the shared Go module.

trailryx.role: the record plane. Runs under two names because the deployments schedule it differently: `trailryx-seal` is the timer in stack-up and the CronJob in stack-k8s, `record-seal` is the long-running compose service in stack-single, which has no cron. Same binary, same command, two shapes.

vouchryx.role: the delegation-token service. Issues RFC 8693 tokens sender-constrained by DPoP, and the revocation list every enforcement point polls, so a delegation can be proved and ended rather than only recorded.

costcrew.role: the FinOps console. A guest producer: it writes the shared envelope and calls nobody, and two of its types are translated into estate vocabulary before they go out.

catalog.role: the estate's own documentation. No check reads it today.

stack-up.role: deployment one: compose plus a governance routines timer.

stack-single.role: deployment two: one box, one compose file.

taipan.why_no_remote: PRIVATE repository with no public remote. CI cannot clone it, so anything it contributes is measured only in a local run.
taipan.role: the CLI. `taipan demo` writes synthetic envelopes attributed to other planes.

bank-in-a-box.why_no_remote: Deliberately has no remote at all (its CLAUDE.md forbids adding one). Local only, by decision.
bank-in-a-box.role: the four-plane integration stand. No check reads it today; its selftest is the model this repo's own selftest follows.
